description: This file contains unit tests for the Calculator application, specifically testing multi-window functionality, multiple calculator modes, and independent state management across instances. It includes tests for standard, scientific, and programmer modes, as well as history and memory list management, and some commented-out date calculator tests.

classes.name: MultiWindowUnitTests
classes.description: A test class containing multiple test methods to validate multi-window calculator functionality, mode switching, independent calculations, history, and memory management.

methods.name: ValidateViewModelMode
methods.description: Validates that the given calculator view model is in the expected mode (standard, scientific, or programmer).
